# M1-C tests. They compile upstream inline DSP (via AudreyVoice.h and
# ReferenceHarness.h), so they apply AB_DSP_OPT_OPTIONS.

# Test inputs (sine_burst.wav, noise_burst.wav), generated by the committed tool
# into the build directory before the parity test runs.
set(AB_TEST_INPUTS ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/inputs)
add_test(NAME gen_test_inputs
    COMMAND $<TARGET_FILE:audrey-gen-input> ${AB_TEST_INPUTS})
set_tests_properties(gen_test_inputs PROPERTIES FIXTURES_SETUP ab_test_inputs)

# Parity: AudreyVoice against the reference harness for every script in scripts/.
add_executable(parity_test parity_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(parity_test PRIVATE audrey_core audrey_ref audrey_tools)
target_compile_options(parity_test PRIVATE ${AB_DSP_OPT_OPTIONS} ${AB_WARNING_OPTIONS})
add_test(NAME parity_test COMMAND parity_test ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/scripts ${AB_TEST_INPUTS})
set_tests_properties(parity_test PROPERTIES FIXTURES_REQUIRED ab_test_inputs TIMEOUT 1200)

# Command-line behaviour of audrey-render and wavcheck.
add_executable(tools_test tools_test.cpp)
target_link_libraries(tools_test PRIVATE audrey_core audrey_tools)
target_compile_options(tools_test PRIVATE ${AB_DSP_OPT_OPTIONS} ${AB_WARNING_OPTIONS})
add_test(NAME tools_test
    COMMAND tools_test $<TARGET_FILE:audrey-render> $<TARGET_FILE:wavcheck> ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/tools_test_tmp)

set_tests_properties(gen_test_inputs parity_test tools_test PROPERTIES
    ENVIRONMENT "UBSAN_OPTIONS=halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1;ASAN_OPTIONS=alloc_dealloc_mismatch=1")
